verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents ongoing monitoring of individual customers and a case-management workflow for reviewing risk alerts raised during that monitoring, via the web app or API. A case audit trail endpoint also exists. However, nothing in the evidence shows the analyst can see what specifically changed, such as new matches, updated profile fields or a before/after diff, so only glancing support is shown. missing for 10: documented change/delta view for monitoring alerts, field-level detail of what triggered the re-alert, comparison against prior screening results, independent or hands-on corroboration.
